# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat youth with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

He is stolid and suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts. He is shy and timid in social situations, decamping in fear when faced with formal invitations, though he takes pride in being near people he admires.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## Traits

- Stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Unconversational  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Fear of formal social invitations  <sub>[v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a horse carriage  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## History

Billy drove his sister Jane, Anne Shirley, and Diana Barry to the White Sands concert in his double-seated buggy. Before setting off, he insisted that Anne sit on the front seat beside him because he immensely admired her and felt proud to drive with her. During the post-concert supper, Billy vanished in mortal fear of being invited to join the high-society event in the dining room, but he faithfully waited outside with the carriage team to drive the girls back home after it was over.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_
